consent.title: Before we start
consent.body: As their parent or guardian, you're uploading your child's photo. It's sent to our AI provider to generate their adventure image. Little Dreamer itself does not save or store the uploaded photo — but as with any online service, we can't make absolute guarantees about data in transit.

name.title: What's your little explorer's name?
name.subtitle: Their name will appear with their photo

capture.title: Take a Photo
capture.subtitle: Take a clear photo of their face, or choose one from your gallery
capture.permissionError: We couldn't access the camera. You can choose a photo from your gallery instead.
capture.unsupportedFormat: That photo format isn't supported here. Please choose a JPG or PNG photo instead.

adventure.title: Choose Their Adventure
adventure.subtitle: Watch their imagination come to life.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't create the image this time. Please try again.
